title: Unified time provider cannot adopt direct NTS RTC manual or local-client sources
description: StratumTracker.consider always requires a DioTimeOption/stratum, while NETWORK evidence always requires link signer/replay/DIO bytes. Thus direct NTS/Roughtime/SNTP and verified RTC/manual/local-client samples have no authoritative adoption path. Separate source-specific provider adoption from peer-DIO adoption with explicit policy/evidence and tests.
